integrity: Proof is supplied with an independent numerical and exact-rational checker; no third-party priority or independent mathematical certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact norms concern affine least-squares projection for normalized uniform facet-area sampling on unit cubes in all dimensions d>=2; asymptotic comparison with uniform volume holds in high dimensions. No claim of a pointwise-in-dimension surface-volume inequality or of higher-degree / arbitrary polytope results.
title: Sharp affine least-squares amplification on cubical surfaces
